newsitem.title: USA: CME pork bellies down limit on further liquidation.
newsitem.headline: CME pork bellies down limit on further liquidation.

text.p: CME pork belly futures fell the 3.000 cent per lb limit in February and March on further long liquidation and sell stops, traders said.
February was down limit at 76.000 cents and March limit down at 75.575 cents. Other months were off 2.975 to 1.600 cents.
Futures continued to fall on concern over deliveries which took prices down into sell stops. Fund liquidation added to losses, traders said.
